name: AI Playwright Sandbox (Antigravity + Claude + Hermes + HF CLI)
postCreateCommand: apt update && apt install -y libmagick++-dev ripgrep ffmpeg && npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code && curl -fsSL https://antigravity.google/cli/install.sh | bash && ln -s /root/.local/bin/agy /usr/local/bin/agy && curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh && ln -sf /root/.local/bin/uv /usr/local/bin/uv && ln -sf /root/.local/bin/uvx /usr/local/bin/uvx && echo "export AGENT_BROWSER_EXECUTABLE_PATH=\$(find /ms-playwright -name chrome -type f | head -n 1)" >> /root/.bashrc && echo 'Antigravity CLI (agy), Claude Code, and UV installed!' && Rscript -e 'install.packages(c("languageserver", "renv"), repos="https://cloud.r-project.org")' && if [ -f renv.lock ]; then Rscript -e 'renv::restore()'; fi && uv pip install --system jupyter ipykernel usd-core huggingface_hub && curl -fsSL https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/install.sh | bash -s -- --skip-setup --skip-browser && echo 'Hermes Agent installed. Run: hermes setup'
